label: accepted

evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a lantern from front, three-quarter and silhouette (hoop ring, cone cap, bulged caged body, wide base); top view still reads via the round cap plus gold ring; A15 symmetry error X/Y = 0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big bulged glass body, medium cone cap and stepped base disc, small hoop ring, collar and six cage bars.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: chunky overhanging cone cap, barrel-bulged glass, oversized hoop; nothing reads as a stiff primitive.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on the gold collar rims, base disc and bar edges catch the studio light; the cap rim edge has a clean bevel highlight.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (cap, glass, base) show smooth shading on glass and cap with no patches, pinches, seams or z-fighting; only intentional low-segment faceting on the hoop ring; A17/A18 pass, 0 flipped faces.
evidence.V6: Disciplined palette: ink dark (cap, base, bars), gold accent (ring, collars), one glow hue in two values (glass + darker band); colourways swap only the glow hue.
evidence.V8: Matches kit: single LF_VertexColor white material, gold/ink/one-hue palette, chamfer scale and smooth shading consistent with the PASS lantern anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Box collision (off when hung), MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic, PointLight at glass centre, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Mild visible faceting on the hoop ring and cap rim outline (low segment count, consistent with kit)
Cage bars end in flat hard cuts on the base collar rather than tucking into it
top_fixes: Tuck the cage bar ends into the top and bottom gold collars (or add small rivet caps) so the bars read as fixed
Add 2-4 segments to the hoop ring to soften its faceted outline at close range
Optionally add a subtle collar or finial where the ring meets the cap to strengthen the small-detail tier
